pattern.description: A signal detail side panel slides in over the list, the list behind it dims, and the view zooms in and drifts toward the panel so its header and fields fill the frame. The caption pill stays fixed.
pattern.why_premium: The zoom picks out the one record that matters and leaves the dimmed list visible at the edge as context, so the viewer follows the drill-down without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(panel, {xPercent: 100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power3.out'}).to(listOverlay, {opacity: 0.6, duration: 0.2}, '<').to(stage, {scale: 1.22, x: -60, y: 40, transformOrigin: '70% 30%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'expo.out'}, '<0.05'); the caption stays outside the stage.
build_hint.remotion: Panel translateX from 100% to 0 over 4-5 frames with interpolate + Easing.out(Easing.cubic). Stage scale 1 to 1.22 with spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 150}) (no overshoot); transform-origin points at the panel header.

notes: The panel is fully open by f1133, so its slide in is fast and may be a UI-native open rather than an edit choice. Code reports camera push_in (scale 1.22), which matches the zoom on b01.
